svg.text: motor_driver_1TB6612FNG dual DC motor driver module
motor_driver_2TB6612FNG dual DC motor driver module
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 7.2 V from SW1: load 1.636 A typical, 6.036 A peak; source 20 A cont, 100 A peak; fuse 4 A
5V_LOGIC 5 V from A1: load 0.019 A typical, 0.019 A peak; source 0.2 A cont, 0.4 A peak
Fuses: F1 4 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch controller). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they protect.
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_vbat, splice_5v_logic) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
